artists.biography: "Public Service Broadcasting"  are a London-based pseudonymous musical group consisting of J. Willgoose, Esq. on guitar, banjo, other stringed instruments, samplings and electronic musical instruments, Wrigglesworth on drums, piano and electronic musical instruments, and J F Abraham on flugelhorn, bass guitar, drums and assorted other instruments including a vibraslap. The band have toured internationally and in 2015 they were announced as nominees in the Vanguard breakthrough category of the fourth annual Progressive Music Awards, staged by Prog magazine, which they won.

perplexity.description:
Bright Magic is Public Service Broadcasting's fourth studio album, released in September 2021 via Play It Again Sam. The record continues the London band's signature approach of blending electronic and rock instrumentation with historical and cultural narratives, this time focusing on Berlin as its central subject. Structured as a three-part suite—Building A City, Building A Myth, and Bright Magic—the album explores the German capital's cultural, political, and artistic dimensions, from its architectural heritage to its role as a free zone for artistic expression. The project incorporates diverse sonic elements, including a guitar riff sampled from Depeche Mode's "People Are People" on the single "People, Let's Dance," which features Berlin-based vocalist EERA.

Musically, the album draws from indie electronic, alternative rock, and post-rock styles, maintaining the band's established practice of "teaching the lessons of the past through the music of the future." The composition spans approximately 46 minutes and demonstrates the band's continued ambition in conceptual album construction, following their previous releases Every Valley (2017) and The Race for Space (2015). The album achieved commercial success, reaching number 2 on the UK Albums Chart, marking a significant chart performance for the band.
